issues.detail: The Greek 'παραγενομενος' (paragenomenos) is a participle modifying the subject 'I'. It means 'having come' or 'having arrived'. The Vietnamese translation 'mà đến' (that [you] came) incorrectly attributes the action of arriving to the person being sent to (the recipient), whereas in Greek, it describes the action of the sender (Peter) who has now arrived.
